test_std_exception: test that pybind11 throws a standard C++ exception translated to a Python RuntimeError
test_cross_module_exceptions: test that exceptions thrown from a separate pybind11 cross-module are correctly raised in Python
test_custom: test custom C++ exception types registered with pybind11 and their translation to Python exceptions
test_nested_throws: test nested exception handling across C++ to Python and back to C++ call chains
test_flaky_exception_failure_point_init: test error_already_set behavior when a Python exception __init__ raises another exception
